item.title: Storing medicines in refrigerator is not ‘manufacturing process’ under Factories Act: Bombay HC
item.description: “The act of preserving or storing is preceded by ‘process for’ preserving or storing any articles in cold storage and it is the process for preserving or storing which amounts to manufacturing process and not the mere act of preserving or storing.” The post Storing medicines in refrigerator is not ‘manufacturing process’ under Factories Act: Bombay HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Purity is the hallmark of justice”: Orissa High Court expunges DSP’s affidavit against Advocate General, restrains media
item.description: “The trust of the people upon this institution should not be believed by encouraging wild litigants to make scurrilous remarks against constitutional functionaries in defiance of the Courts’ orders.” The post “Purity is the hallmark of justice”: Orissa High Court expunges DSP’s affidavit against Advocate General, restrains media appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Mandatory to issue notice under S. 35(3) BNSS to accused regarding offences punishable with 7 yrs imprisonment: Supreme Court clarifies
item.description: An arrest by a police officer is a mere statutory discretion which facilitates him to conduct proper investigation, in the form of collection of evidence and, therefore, shall not be termed as mandatory. The post Mandatory to issue notice under S. 35(3) BNSS to accused regarding offences punishable with 7 yrs imprisonment: Supreme Court clarifies appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Recognising Indian Pickleball Association as National Sports Federation is policy decision; Delhi HC refuses to reassess comparative merits of rival bodies
item.description: “The Sports Code is policy-driven and cannot be applied mechanically. The adoption of a “one size fits all” approach would be an anathema to the objective and purport of the Sports Code, particularly in the context of nascent and emerging sports”.
